''See also: [[Emperor (Elder Empire) Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Emperor was the long-standing ruler of the [[Aurelian Empire]], a position he held for nearly two millennia. He was characterized by an immense and [[Iron|iron-willed]] [[Intent]] that could overwhelm others, as well as a profound distance from humanity that made him appear more like an Elder than a man. His longevity was tied to the [[Great Elders]], specifically through his use of one of [[Nakothi]]'s hearts to sustain his life. He was a figure of immense power who had personally confronted and defeated [[Great Elders]], including the one responsible for the creation of the [[Aion Sea]]. To govern and protect his civilization, the Emperor utilized a specialized device known as the [[Optasia]]. This throne functioned as a global receptor network that amplified his ability to [[Read]], allowing him to monitor the [[Great Elders]] and respond to threats across the world. However, using this technology was dangerous, as it exposed him to the attention and potential corruption of the [[Elders]]. The Emperor's death, which some believe he allowed to happen, triggered a period of chaos known as the [[Long Mourning]]. His passing left [[The Empire|the Empire]] fragmented and vulnerable to Elder activity, leading to a struggle for leadership between various [[Guilds]] and [[Regents]]. While he sought to protect humanity from being consumed by the [[Elders]], his singular [[Authority|authority]] also created a vulnerability, as the [[Great Elders]] could potentially seize control of the entire world by possessing a single ruler.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Emperor wore white armor and a simple, single-layered white robe with layers of silk in every shade of blue. His trademark attire included a wide-brimmed hat, a crown, and a [[silver chain]] around his neck.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Possessing boundless resolve and an [[Iron|iron]] will, the Emperor was a figure of [[Authority|authority]] who served [[The Empire|the Empire]] and the world. Though he had done many bad things in his time and could be removed from humanity, he believed no sacrifice was too great to prevent the rise of the [[Elders]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Emperor had long proximity to [[Naberius Clayborn|Naberius]] in the [[Imperial]] Palace, provided tutelage to [[Loreli]], and required the service of [[Shera]], whom he trained with cautionary tales. He killed [[Nakothi]] with a spear, compensated [[Ulrich Fletcher]] for lost business, ordered [[Alsa Grayweather]] to be kept in [[Guild]] custody, and signed a release for [[Baldezar Kern]]. He also broke [[Lucan]]'s legs, spared [[Calder]] from execution, and was praised by [[Yala the High Mason|Yala]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|As a Reader with overwhelming powers, the Emperor could use [[Intent]] to levitate wagons, create doors in walls, awaken gravel, and bring inanimate objects to life. He could sense the potential in objects, use the [[Optasia]] to control amplification devices, and bind himself to a [[Great Elder]]'s heart without going mad. His skills included dissolving objects with his will, jumping from great heights, and crafting a ghost by layering memories into his belongings.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Imperial Authority}} ===

Darkness'', chapter 4</ref> Despite making numerous decisions for the [[Guilds]], he remains indifferent toward people and is regarded as the father of all.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c7">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c8">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 8</ref> He communicates via Navigators bearing the [[Imperial Seal]] and stands as the sole individual to have directly witnessed [[Ach'magut|Ach’magut]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c9">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c11">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 11</ref> [[Calder]] is the Emperor and is destined to hold this position one day.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c12">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 12</ref> As an exception to the rule that [[Readers]] should not rule the populace, he is a figure of [[Authority|authority]] whom people are encouraged to protect.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c14">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 14</ref><ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c16">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 16</ref> He constructed a global network of relay statues resembling himself and allegedly employed watchers to ensure the [[Optasia]] remained sealed away from him.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c16" /> The Emperor specified the design of [[Calder]]'s carriage and has invested thousands of [[goldmarks]] into the construction of [[The Testament]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c18">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 18</ref><ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c19">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 19</ref> His [[Authority|authority]] is invoked by the [[Imperial Steward]] as he issues orders to search for suspicious vessels.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c20">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 20</ref><ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c21">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 21</ref> Though he has no official duties, the Emperor is a figurehead possessing absolute power to indulge his whims.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c23">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 23</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The Great Elders}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Following his murder, the Emperor's legacy is defined by a conviction that no sacrifice is too great to stop the [[Elders]] from rising.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c1">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 1</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c3">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 3</ref> He previously engaged in combat with [[Shera]] within the heart of the [[dead island]] and has acknowledged that his centuries-long life is nearing its conclusion.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c3" /> Throughout his nearly two millennia of existence, he has explored the various possibilities of [[Intent]] and once successfully sealed the [[Great Elder]] [[Ach'magut|Ach’magut]] inside an ancient library.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c4">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c5">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 5</ref> Despite being considered safe even against a hostile army appearing directly upon him, he has become a target for [[Lucan]]'s squad.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c7">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 7</ref> Clad in layers of silk in every shade of blue, the Emperor is unable to use the [[Optasia]] and can no longer provide protection for his people.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c7" />}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">12</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The Emperor believes no sacrifice is too great to prevent the rise of the [[Elders]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c3" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Shera]] has fought the Emperor in the heart of the [[dead island]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c3" />}}</li>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Of Darkness and Dawn}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|After escaping the [[Elders]], the Emperor took a name for himself and gained the ability to bring inanimate objects to life.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c9">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c10">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 10</ref> He has personally trained the [[Gardeners]] and once experienced insanity while in the belly of the [[dead island]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c12">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 12</ref> Driven by a goal to serve the entire world and [[The Empire|the Empire]], his words carry an impossible-to-ignore [[Intent]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c14">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 14</ref> Having outlived everyone else in the history of [[The Empire|the Empire]], he now faces the threat of Elder possession.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c14" /><ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c15">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 15</ref> The Emperor possesses the power to drag anyone he chooses and previously attempted to [[construct]] large or intricate Optasias.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c15" /><ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c16">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 16</ref> Clad in a simple, single-layered white robe, he rarely allows [[Shera]] to see his rooms and has even instructed her to execute him should he lose control of himself.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c16" /> While lounging in his cage-like throne, the former slave to the [[Great Elders]] used his [[Intent]] to halt an Elder or destroy things.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c18">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 18</ref> Though he has changed from what [[Ach'magut]] predicted, he continued to correct Elder-related problems from his throne and received praise from [[Yala the High Mason|Yala]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c18" /><ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c19">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 19</ref> With an eye that sees all, he can flex his [[Intent]] to make flames flare, produce hazy bubbles in the [[Optasia]], or drag a massive shark from the [[Aion Sea]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c20">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 20</ref> At full power, his [[Active Reading|active Reading]] would have torn [[Shera]] to pieces, but he was eventually killed by her.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c20" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Imperial Relics}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Emperor possessed powers that could be referenced through [[Imperial relics]] and lived for over two thousand years while protecting everyone from the [[Elders]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c2">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c4">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 4</ref> Driven by a desire for peaceful sleep, he invested his bed with [[Intent]], and he was known to wear a crown and trademark attire that included a wide-brimmed hat.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c4" /><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c5">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c7">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 7</ref> His power was trusted by the [[Regents]] and felt as a projected force of will by [[Calder]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c9">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c11">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 11</ref> By layering memories into his belongings and molding his [[Intent]], the Emperor could craft a ghost.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c17">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 17</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c22">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 22</ref> The Capital swelled with people for his funeral, and his painted images remain on walls to protect spirits.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c19">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 19</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c21">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 21</ref> To defy him is to defy civilization, humanity, and [[The Empire|the Empire]] itself.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c21" /> A self-educated son of a wine merchant once known as [[Sadesthenes]], the Emperor claimed to be the first Reader and asserted that his teachings held [[Authority|authority]] beyond the [[Guild of Magisters]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c22" /><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 25</ref> He possessed an [[Iron|iron]] will forged in war and ultimately gave up his life to avoid losing a battle to the [[Elders]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c22" /><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 24</ref> To bolster his will against [[Nakothi]]'s corruption, he left a comprehensive [[Intent]] in the [[Optasia]] to create a powerful personality echo.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25" />}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">24</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Emperor invested the armor to protect and preserve the life of the wearer.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c17" />}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Emperor's images are painted on walls in the Capital to protect spirits.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c21" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Defying the Emperor is considered defying [[The Empire|the Empire]], civilization, and humanity.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c21" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Emperor has [[Read]] [[Elders]] before.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c22" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Emperor claims to be the first Reader and asserts that the [[Guild of Magisters]] has no [[Authority|authority]] over his teachings.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c22" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Emperor crafts a ghost by layering his memories into his belongings and molding his [[Intent]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c22" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Emperor possesses boundless resolve and an [[Iron|iron]] will forged in war.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c22" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Emperor gave up his life rather than losing a battle to the [[Elders]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Emperor left a clear, comprehensive [[Intent]] in the [[Optasia]] to create an echo of his personality.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Emperor's personality echo was intended to bolster his will against [[Nakothi]]'s corruption.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Emperor was once known by the name [[Sadesthenes]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Emperor's persona as [[Sadesthenes]] was the self-educated son of a wine merchant.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Emperor and [[Calder]] woke in the same body.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Emperor's echo is a force to be reckoned with.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Of Killers and Kings}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Shera]] ended the life of the Emperor in service to the Independent cause.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c2">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 2</ref> Though he was once hailed as [[the Liberator]] by those he saved, he currently claims his title as Emperor despite suffering from a broken foot, bruises, minor cuts, and a possible cracked rib.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c3">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 3</ref> The Emperor of humanity was killed half a year ago via a sawing motion and knife-thrust.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c5">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 5</ref> Having borrowed power from [[Nakothi]], the Emperor possessed an [[Intent]] strong enough to erase the wills of ordinary people.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c7">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c9">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 9</ref> The Emperor served as the moral compass for the [[Guild]], though the real ruler actually allowed himself to die.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c10">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 10</ref> The [[Architects]] would alter their timelines to serve him, and his death left the world to decide its own [[Fate|fate]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c11">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c13">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 13</ref> The Emperor has already decided who will rule the world and maintains personal connections with both the [[Guild Heads]] and the [[Regents]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c13" /> He is capable of hiding his [[Intent]] from [[Reading]] and wears armor, including a helmet that was struck by the blade of [[Bastion]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c15">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c16">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 16</ref> The Emperor provided personal attention to enhance [[Shera]] and [[Lucan]], and he first contacted [[Yala the High Mason|Yala]] over two years ago.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c17">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 17</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Of Killers and Kings}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Emperor is a historical figure who once provided tutelage to [[Loreli]] to hone her talent.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c18">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 18</ref> For nearly two thousand years, he has carried a [[Great Elder]]'s heart.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c20">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 20</ref> Before his reign, the position of Emperor had been held by only one other person.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c21">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 21</ref> [[Shera]] is accustomed to being in his presence, though he may be linked to the strength of the urges found in her [[shears]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c21" /><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 22</ref> He once remarked that all men were allies prior to the era of the [[Elders]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 24</ref> During his time with [[Shera]], he shared precautionary tales regarding those who dealt with [[Kelarac]] and advised her that she needed to be ruthless.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 25</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 26</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">9</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Emperor is a historical figure.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c18" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Loreli]] honed her talent under the Emperor’s tutelage.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c18" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Emperor has carried a [[Great Elder]]’s heart for almost two thousand years.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c20" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The position of Emperor was previously held by only one person.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c21" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Emperor is a figure [[Shera]] is used to being in the presence of.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c21" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Emperor is potentially related to the strength of urges in [[Shera's shears]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Emperor stated that before the [[Elders]], all men are allies.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Emperor taught [[Shera]] precautionary tales about those who dealt with [[Kelarac]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Emperor told [[Shera]] she needed to be ruthless.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“Nobody wants to be the Emperor?” Calder spat out.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c14" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“The future Emperor is boarding,” the Guard said simply.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c16" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“Guild Head, we were ordered by the Emperor himself to keep her in Guild custody.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c28" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|“The Emperor has given us permission to do everything we can,” they’d said.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c8" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|“That’s not possible,” Lucan whispered. “He’s Awakening the gravel.”<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c9" />}}
